blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — About 85 percent of takers passed the licensure examination for chemical engineers, the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announced on Thursday. According to the PRC, 814 out of 955 examinees successfully passed the November 2026 Chemical Engineer Licensure Examination. Timothy John Alcantara Jala from the University of San Carlos topped the exam with a 93% score. He was followed by Cyra Pineda Panganiban from the University of the Philippines (UP)-Los Baños at Top 2 (91%) and Alessandro Niño Glindro ROA from UP-Diliman at Top 3 (90.8%).
